answer: Topological Neighborhood Binding. Each agent's transaction thread is scored by the diversity of independent counterparties reachable within two hops, measured as edge-disjoint paths; a new identity inherits only the minimum diversity of the peers that first route to it. Sybils created in a cluster share paths, so their reachable diversity stays low and transaction limits stay throttled.
